## Module 05. 差异 Peak 分析 (DiffBind)

使用 `DiffBind` 包进行差异可及性分析。

```{r diffbind_cache_gate, include=FALSE}
diff_tables_reused <- FALSE
diff_state_reused <- FALSE

if(isTRUE(reuse_step_tables) && file.exists(cache_05_differential_accessibility_state_path)) {
  diff_cached_payload <- load_state("05_differential_accessibility_state.rds", env = globalenv(), required = FALSE)
  cache_has_project_schema <- !is.null(diff_cached_payload) && exists("all_res_df") &&
    is.data.frame(all_res_df) &&
    all(c("PvalueDiffPeak", "FDRDiffPeak", "PrimaryDiffPeak",
          "SelectedSignificanceMetric", "SelectedSignificanceValue", "SelectedSignificanceThreshold") %in% colnames(all_res_df))
  cache_is_native_diffbind <- exists("diff_peak_source_audit_tbl") &&
    is.data.frame(diff_peak_source_audit_tbl) &&
    "AnalysisSource" %in% colnames(diff_peak_source_audit_tbl) &&
    any(diff_peak_source_audit_tbl$AnalysisSource == "native_diffbind")
  if(isTRUE(cache_has_project_schema) && isTRUE(cache_is_native_diffbind)) {
    # 重新应用当前显著性门和统一 peak ID；已有图不能跳过修正后的重画。
    report_status("INFO", "Reusing native DiffBind counts and estimates; regenerating current peak layers and plots.")
    diff_tables_reused <- TRUE
    diff_state_reused <- TRUE
  } else if(isTRUE(cache_has_project_schema)) {
    report_status("WARN", "Existing module 5 cache has no native DiffBind provenance; recomputing from BAM and peak files.")
  } else {
    report_status("WARN", "Existing DiffBind cache uses an old differential-peak schema; recomputing module 5.")
  }
}
```

```{r diffbind_table_reuse_gate, include=FALSE}
read_first_existing_csv <- function(files) {
  files <- files[file.exists(files)]
  if(length(files) == 0) return(data.frame())
  read.csv(files[1], stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
}

write_diff_peak_layers <- function(all_df) {
  all_df <- standardize_diff_peak_df(all_df)
  layers <- list(
    primary = filter_diff_peaks(all_df, mode = "primary"),
    pvalue = all_df %>% filter(PvalueDiffPeak),
    fdr = all_df %>% filter(FDRDiffPeak)
  )
  write.csv(all_df, step_table_file("Step5", "Differential_Peaks_AllSites.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(layers$primary, step_table_file("Step5", "Differential_Peaks.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(layers$pvalue, step_table_file("Step5", "Differential_Peaks_Pvalue.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(layers$fdr, step_table_file("Step5", "Differential_Peaks_FDR.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  layers
}

diff_sample_count_columns <- function(df) {
  if(is.null(df) || !is.data.frame(df) || ncol(df) == 0) return(character())
  # Only explicitly declared sample columns are counts; numeric metadata are not samples.
  order_sample_columns(intersect(samples, colnames(df)))
}

build_counts_norm_from_diff_table <- function(df) {
  df <- standardize_diff_peak_df(df)
  sample_cols <- diff_sample_count_columns(df)
  if(length(sample_cols) == 0) return(data.frame())

  keep_cols <- unique(c(intersect(c("CHR", "START", "END", "Chr", "Start", "End", "seqnames", "start", "end", "peak_id"), colnames(df)), sample_cols))
  out <- df[, keep_cols, drop = FALSE]
  if(!"CHR" %in% colnames(out)) out$CHR <- if("seqnames" %in% colnames(out)) out$seqnames else NA_character_
  if(!"START" %in% colnames(out)) out$START <- if("start" %in% colnames(out)) out$start else NA_integer_
  if(!"END" %in% colnames(out)) out$END <- if("end" %in% colnames(out)) out$end else NA_integer_
  out$peak_id_join <- canonical_peak_id(out$CHR, out$START, out$END)
  out$peak_id <- out$peak_id_join
  for(nm in sample_cols) out[[nm]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(out[[nm]]))
  out
}

# DiffBind test intervals are summit-centred and 1-based. Upstream BED consensus
# intervals are a different feature universe and cannot replace their count rows.
normalize_diffbind_count_ids <- function(df) {
  if(!is.data.frame(df) || nrow(df) == 0) return(data.frame())
  if(all(c("CHR", "START", "END") %in% names(df))) {
    count_start <- if("START_1BASED" %in% names(df)) df$START_1BASED else df$START
    df$peak_id_join <- canonical_peak_id(df$CHR, count_start, df$END)
  } else if(all(c("seqnames", "start", "end") %in% names(df))) {
    df$peak_id_join <- canonical_peak_id(df$seqnames, df$start, df$end)
  } else {
    return(data.frame())
  }
  if(anyDuplicated(df$peak_id_join)) stop("Duplicate count coordinates after peak-ID normalization")
  df$peak_id <- df$peak_id_join
  df
}
```

```{r diffbind_setup}
if(!isTRUE(diff_tables_reused)) {
  # 创建 Sample Sheet
  sampleSheet <- data.frame(
    SampleID = samples,
    Condition = conditions,
    bamReads = bam_files,
    Peaks = peak_files,
    PeakCaller = "narrow"
  )

  # 读取数据 (dba object)
  # 注意：如果 Peak 文件很多，这一步可能需要一些时间
  atac_dba <- dba(sampleSheet = sampleSheet, minOverlap = atac_diffbind_min_overlap)

  # 计算 Count Matrix (基于共有 Peak) - 优化参数
  atac_dba <- dba.count(
    atac_dba,
    summits = atac_diffbind_summits,
    bUseSummarizeOverlaps = TRUE,
    bRemoveDuplicates = FALSE,
    mapQCth = 0,
    filter = atac_diffbind_rpkm_filter,
    filterFun = atac_diffbind_filter_fun,
    minCount = atac_diffbind_min_count,
    bParallel = FALSE
  )
} else {
  report_status("INFO", "Skipping DiffBind object construction; module 5 is using an existing differential table.")
}

# 样本相关性热图在提取标准化计数矩阵后用固定列顺序绘制，
# 避免热图聚类把 Reference/control 与处理组左右顺序打乱。
```

```{r pca_plot}
# PCA 分析
# 手动计算 PCA 以避免 dba.plotPCA 的 lattice 错误
if(!isTRUE(diff_tables_reused) && exists("atac_dba") && !is.null(atac_dba)) {
  counts_norm <- dba.peakset(atac_dba, bRetrieve=TRUE, DataType=DBA_DATA_FRAME)
} else if(!exists("counts_norm") || !is.data.frame(counts_norm) || nrow(counts_norm) == 0) {
  counts_norm <- build_counts_norm_from_diff_table(all_res_df)
}

if((!exists("counts_norm") || !is.data.frame(counts_norm) || nrow(counts_norm) == 0 ||
    length(diff_sample_count_columns(counts_norm)) < 2) &&
   exists("consensus_cpm_count_matrix") && is.data.frame(consensus_cpm_count_matrix) &&
   nrow(consensus_cpm_count_matrix) > 0) {
  counts_norm <- consensus_cpm_count_matrix
  report_status("INFO", "Using upstream CPM consensus count matrix for Module05 PCA/correlation fallback.")
}

sample_cols <- diff_sample_count_columns(counts_norm)
save_step_table(data.frame(
  CountSource = if("START_1BASED" %in% names(counts_norm)) "upstream consensus CPM" else "DiffBind normalized counts",
  PeakRows = nrow(counts_norm), SampleColumns = paste(sample_cols, collapse = ";"),
  EvidenceRole = "descriptive sample PCA/correlation; no sample selection"
), "Step5", "Sample_Exploration_Count_Source.csv")

if(length(sample_cols) >= 2 && nrow(counts_norm) > 1) {
  count_mat <- as.matrix(counts_norm[, sample_cols, drop = FALSE])
  storage.mode(count_mat) <- "numeric"
  count_mat[is.na(count_mat)] <- 0

  # 过滤低表达 Peak (可选)
  # count_mat <- count_mat[rowSums(count_mat) > 10, ]

  log_counts <- log2(count_mat + 1)

  sample_cor <- stats::cor(log_counts, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
  sample_cor <- sample_cor[sample_cols, sample_cols, drop = FALSE]
  save_step_table(
    data.frame(SampleID = rownames(sample_cor), sample_cor, check.names = FALSE),
    "Step5",
    "Sample_Correlation_Matrix.csv"
  )
  sample_cor_anno <- data.frame(
    Group = factor(sample_group(sample_cols), levels = group_levels),
    row.names = sample_cols
  )
  draw_pheatmap_dual(
    step_plot_file("Step5", "Sample_Correlation_Heatmap.pdf"),
    width = 8,
    height = 8,
    legend_title = "Pearson r",
    pheatmap(
      sample_cor,
      cluster_rows = FALSE,
      cluster_cols = FALSE,
      annotation_col = sample_cor_anno,
      annotation_row = sample_cor_anno,
      annotation_colors = list(Group = viz_pal$group),
      color = viz_pal$heat_meth,
      breaks = seq(-1, 1, length.out = length(viz_pal$heat_meth) + 1),
      legend_breaks = c(-1, 0, 1), legend_labels = c("-1", "0", "1"),
      na_col = unname(pfos_palette("neutral")["missing"]),
      main = paste0("Sample correlation heatmap (", baseline_group, " left, ", treatment_group, " right)")
    )
  )

  pca_res <- prcomp(t(log_counts), scale. = TRUE)
  pca_df <- as.data.frame(pca_res$x)
  pca_df$SampleID <- rownames(pca_df)
  var_explained <- round(pca_res$sdev^2 / sum(pca_res$sdev^2) * 100, 1)

  pca_df$Condition <- sample_group(pca_df$SampleID)
  if(exists("sampleSheet")) {
    for(i in seq_len(nrow(pca_df))) {
      idx <- which(sampleSheet$SampleID == pca_df$SampleID[i])
      if(length(idx) > 0) {
        pca_df$Condition[i] <- as.character(sampleSheet$Condition[idx][1])
      } else {
        idx <- grep(pca_df$SampleID[i], sampleSheet$SampleID)
        if(length(idx) > 0) pca_df$Condition[i] <- as.character(sampleSheet$Condition[idx[1]])
      }
    }
  }
  pca_df$Condition <- factor(pca_df$Condition, levels = c(group_levels, "Unknown"))

  write.csv(pca_df, step_table_file("Step5", "Sample_PCA_Scores.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

  pca_colors <- c(viz_pal$group, "Unknown" = viz_pal$neutral_mid)
  p_pca <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(x=PC1, y=PC2, color=Condition, label=SampleID)) +
    geom_point(size=4, alpha = 0.95) +
    geom_text_repel() +
    scale_color_manual(values = pca_colors) +
    theme_atac_classic(base_size = 12) +
    labs(title="PCA of ATAC-seq Samples",
         x=paste0("PC1 (", var_explained[1], "%)"),
         y=paste0("PC2 (", var_explained[2], "%)"))

  if(emit_light_plots) {
    save_plot_pdf(p_pca, step_plot_file("Step5", "Sample_PCA.pdf"), width = 8, height = 8)
    print(p_pca)
  }
} else {
  count_mat <- matrix(numeric(), nrow = 0, ncol = 0)
  log_counts <- count_mat
  pca_res <- NULL
  pca_df <- data.frame()
  var_explained <- numeric()
  write_skipped_state(
    "Step5",
    "Sample_Correlation_Heatmap",
    "Fewer than two sample count columns were available for correlation plotting.",
    clear_plot_files = "Sample_Correlation_Heatmap.pdf"
  )
  write_skipped_state(
    "Step5",
    "Sample_PCA",
    "Fewer than two sample count columns were available for PCA plotting.",
    clear_plot_files = "Sample_PCA.pdf"
  )
}
```

```{r diff_analysis}
if(!isTRUE(diff_tables_reused)) {
  # comparison-reference direction comes from validated public configuration.
  atac_dba <- dba.contrast(atac_dba, contrast = c("Condition", treatment_group, baseline_group))
  print(dba.show(atac_dba, bContrasts = TRUE))

  # DESeq2 is primary; edgeR is a sensitivity analysis on the identical DBA count/design.
  atac_dba <- dba.analyze(atac_dba, method = c(DBA_DESEQ2, DBA_EDGER), bParallel = FALSE)

  dba_report_all <- dba.report(atac_dba, method = DBA_DESEQ2, th = 1, bUsePval = FALSE, fold = 0)
  all_res_df <- standardize_diff_peak_df(as.data.frame(dba_report_all))
  diff_layers <- write_diff_peak_layers(all_res_df)
  res_df <- diff_layers$primary
  pvalue_res_df <- diff_layers$pvalue
  fdr_res_df <- diff_layers$fdr
  nominal_res_df <- filter_diff_peaks(all_res_df, mode = "nominal")
  dba_res <- diff_peak_granges(res_df)

  edger_report_all <- dba.report(atac_dba, method = DBA_EDGER, th = 1, bUsePval = FALSE, fold = 0)
  edger_res_df <- standardize_diff_peak_df(as.data.frame(edger_report_all))
  method_concordance_tbl <- all_res_df %>%
    select(peak_id, seqnames, start, end, DESeq2_Fold = Fold, DESeq2_pvalue = pvalue, DESeq2_FDR = FDR,
           DESeq2_Primary = PrimaryDiffPeak) %>%
    inner_join(
      edger_res_df %>%
        select(peak_id, edgeR_Fold = Fold, edgeR_pvalue = pvalue, edgeR_FDR = FDR, edgeR_Primary = PrimaryDiffPeak),
      by = "peak_id"
    ) %>%
    distinct(peak_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
  if(nrow(method_concordance_tbl) != nrow(all_res_df) || nrow(method_concordance_tbl) != nrow(edger_res_df)) {
    stop("DESeq2 与 edgeR 未返回完全相同的 peak universe；停止生成不可比的敏感性结果")
  }
  method_concordance_tbl <- method_concordance_tbl %>%
    mutate(
      DirectionConsistent = sign(DESeq2_Fold) == sign(edgeR_Fold),
      SelectedByEither = DESeq2_Primary | edgeR_Primary,
      SelectedByBoth = DESeq2_Primary & edgeR_Primary
    )
  selected_union_n <- sum(method_concordance_tbl$SelectedByEither, na.rm = TRUE)
  method_sensitivity_summary <- data.frame(
    Comparison = contrast_label,
    EvidenceRole = "exploratory sensitivity analysis; n=2 per group",
    CommonPeakCount = nrow(method_concordance_tbl),
    DESeq2PrimaryCount = sum(method_concordance_tbl$DESeq2_Primary, na.rm = TRUE),
    edgeRPrimaryCount = sum(method_concordance_tbl$edgeR_Primary, na.rm = TRUE),
    DirectionAgreementRate = mean(method_concordance_tbl$DirectionConsistent, na.rm = TRUE),
    FoldSpearman = suppressWarnings(cor(method_concordance_tbl$DESeq2_Fold, method_concordance_tbl$edgeR_Fold,
                                        method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")),
    SignificantSetJaccard = if(selected_union_n > 0) sum(method_concordance_tbl$SelectedByBoth, na.rm = TRUE) / selected_union_n else NA_real_,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  write.csv(method_concordance_tbl, step_table_file("Step5", "DESeq2_edgeR_Peak_Concordance.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(method_sensitivity_summary, step_table_file("Step5", "DESeq2_edgeR_Sensitivity_Summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

  # 方向性快速检查
  if("Fold" %in% colnames(res_df)) {
    cat("Up (", treatment_group, " > ", baseline_group, "): ", sum(res_df$Fold > 0), "\n", sep = "")
    cat("Down (", treatment_group, " < ", baseline_group, "): ", sum(res_df$Fold < 0), "\n", sep = "")
  }

  cat("全量 DiffBind 位点数量:", nrow(all_res_df), "\n")
  cat("正式差异 Peak 数量 (", primary_diff_peak_label(), "): ", nrow(res_df), "\n", sep = "")
  cat("p-value 差异 Peak 数量 (", nominal_diff_peak_label(), "): ", nrow(nominal_res_df), "\n", sep = "")
  head(res_df)

  # 保存差异结果
  diff_peak_source_audit_tbl <- data.frame(
    AnalysisSource = "native_diffbind",
    AnalysisSignature = current_analysis_signature,
    AnalysisMethod = paste0(
      "DiffBind dba.count(minOverlap=", atac_diffbind_min_overlap,
      ",summits=", atac_diffbind_summits,
      ",filter=RPKM,filterFun=", atac_diffbind_filter_fun_name,
      ",minCount=", atac_diffbind_min_count,
      ") -> DESeq2 primary + edgeR sensitivity"
    ),
    DiffBindRPKMFilter = atac_diffbind_rpkm_filter,
    DiffBindMinOverlap = atac_diffbind_min_overlap,
    DiffBindSummits = atac_diffbind_summits,
    DiffBindFilterFun = atac_diffbind_filter_fun_name,
    DiffBindMinCount = atac_diffbind_min_count,
    ReferenceGroup = baseline_group,
    ComparisonGroup = treatment_group,
    DifferentialPeakTable = step_table_file("Step5", "Differential_Peaks_AllSites.csv"),
    BAMFiles = paste(bam_files, collapse = ";"),
    PeakFiles = paste(peak_files, collapse = ";"),
    SampleIDs = paste(samples, collapse = ";"),
    Conditions = paste(conditions, collapse = ";"),
    ReferenceGenome = "GRCm39/mm39",
    ExternalDiffTableUsed = FALSE,
    CreatedAt = as.character(Sys.time()),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  write.csv(diff_peak_source_audit_tbl, source_audit_file, row.names = FALSE)
  if(!(atac_significance_mode == "pvalue" && identical(format_threshold(atac_nominal_p_cutoff), format_threshold(atac_primary_p_cutoff)))) {
    write.csv(nominal_res_df, step_table_file("Step5", "Differential_Peaks_Nominal_Exploratory.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  }

  differential_threshold_definitions <- data.frame(
    Tier = c("Current primary", "P-value", "FDR/padj", "Nominal/exploratory"),
    OutputFile = c(
      "Differential_Peaks.csv",
      "Differential_Peaks_Pvalue.csv",
      "Differential_Peaks_FDR.csv",
      ifelse(
        (atac_significance_mode == "pvalue" && identical(format_threshold(atac_nominal_p_cutoff), format_threshold(atac_primary_p_cutoff))),
        "not written when identical to Differential_Peaks.csv",
        "Differential_Peaks_Nominal_Exploratory.csv"
      )
    ),
    Threshold = c(
      primary_diff_peak_label(),
      primary_pvalue_diff_peak_label(),
      paste0("FDR <= ", format_threshold(atac_diff_fdr_cutoff)),
      nominal_diff_peak_label()
    ),
    DownstreamUse = c(
      "Primary project result set; all ATAC downstream modules use PrimaryDiffPeak.",
      "Fixed p-value layer, retained independently of the selected primary mode.",
      "Fixed multiple-testing-controlled layer, retained independently of the selected primary mode.",
      "Exploratory-only support; do not use alone for strong conclusions."
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  write.csv(
    differential_threshold_definitions,
    step_table_file("Step5", "Differential_Threshold_Definitions.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
} else {
  report_status("INFO", "Skipping DiffBind differential analysis; module 5 is using a standardized existing comparison table.")
}
```

```{r advanced_diff_plots, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
unlink(vapply(c("Volcano_Plot", "Scatter_Plot_DiffPeaks", "Top_DiffPeaks_Heatmap"),
              function(x) step_table_file("Step5", paste0(x, "_Skipped_State.csv")), character(1)))
# --- 高级图表 3: 差异 Peak 火山图 (Volcano Plot) ---
if(nrow(all_res_df) > 0) {
  volcano_df <- all_res_df %>%
    mutate(
      PlotP = SelectedSignificanceValue,
      logP = -log10(pmax(PlotP, 1e-300))
    )
  p_volcano <- ggplot(volcano_df, aes(x = Fold, y = logP, color = ifelse(PrimaryDiffPeak & Fold > 0, "up", ifelse(PrimaryDiffPeak & Fold < 0, "down", "ns")))) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.75, size = 1.8) +
    scale_color_manual(values = viz_pal$de[c("down", "up", "ns")], breaks = c("down", "up", "ns"), name = "Selected direction") +
    theme_atac_classic(base_size = 12) +
    labs(title="Volcano Plot of Differential Peaks", 
         subtitle=paste("Primary threshold:", primary_diff_peak_label()),
         x="Log2 Fold Change", 
         y=paste0("-Log10 ", ifelse(atac_significance_column == "pvalue", "p-value", "FDR/padj"))) +
    geom_vline(xintercept=c(-atac_diff_log2fc_cutoff, atac_diff_log2fc_cutoff), linetype="dashed") +
    geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(if(atac_significance_column == "pvalue") atac_primary_p_cutoff else atac_diff_fdr_cutoff), linetype="dashed")
  
  if(emit_light_plots) {
    print(p_volcano)
    save_gg_dual(step_plot_file("Step5", "Volcano_Plot.pdf"), p_volcano, width = 8, height = 6)
  }

  # --- 高级图表 3.1: 差异 Peak 散点图 (Scatter Plot) ---
  # 复用差异表时没有 DiffBind 对象，因此从标准化表中的样本 count 列直接绘图。
  if(!exists("counts_norm") || !is.data.frame(counts_norm) || nrow(counts_norm) == 0) {
    if(exists("atac_dba") && !is.null(atac_dba)) {
      counts_norm <- dba.peakset(atac_dba, bRetrieve=TRUE, DataType=DBA_DATA_FRAME)
    } else {
      counts_norm <- build_counts_norm_from_diff_table(all_res_df)
    }
  }
  if((!is.data.frame(counts_norm) || nrow(counts_norm) == 0 ||
      length(diff_sample_count_columns(counts_norm)) < 2) &&
     exists("consensus_cpm_count_matrix") && is.data.frame(consensus_cpm_count_matrix) &&
     nrow(consensus_cpm_count_matrix) > 0) {
    counts_norm <- consensus_cpm_count_matrix
    report_status("INFO", "Checking upstream CPM intervals for exact agreement with tested peaks; mismatched consensus intervals will not enter differential plots.")
  }

  counts_norm <- normalize_diffbind_count_ids(counts_norm)
  sample_cols <- diff_sample_count_columns(counts_norm)
  tested_ids <- all_res_df$peak_id_join
  matched_count_ids <- intersect(counts_norm$peak_id_join, tested_ids)
  save_step_table(data.frame(
    TestedPeakCount = length(tested_ids), CountPeakCount = nrow(counts_norm),
    ExactCoordinateMatches = length(matched_count_ids),
    CoordinateSystem = "1-based closed; chromosome prefix canonicalized",
    EvidenceRole = "Only exactly matched tested intervals enter differential plots"
  ), "Step5", "Differential_Count_Coordinate_Match.csv")
  counts_norm <- if(length(matched_count_ids) == length(tested_ids)) {
    counts_norm[counts_norm$peak_id_join %in% tested_ids, , drop = FALSE]
  } else {
    data.frame()
  }
  sample_cols <- diff_sample_count_columns(counts_norm)
  if(nrow(counts_norm) > 0) save_step_table(counts_norm, "Step5", "DiffBind_Normalized_Counts.csv")

  if(length(sample_cols) > 0) {
    for(nm in sample_cols) counts_norm[[nm]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(counts_norm[[nm]]))
  }

  baseline_cols <- sample_cols[sample_group(sample_cols) == baseline_group]
  treatment_cols <- sample_cols[sample_group(sample_cols) == treatment_group]

  if(nrow(counts_norm) > 0 && length(baseline_cols) > 0 && length(treatment_cols) > 0 && "peak_id_join" %in% colnames(counts_norm)) {
    counts_norm$Mean_Baseline <- rowMeans(counts_norm[, baseline_cols, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
    counts_norm$Mean_Treatment <- rowMeans(counts_norm[, treatment_cols, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)

    scatter_data <- counts_norm %>%
      dplyr::select(peak_id_join, Mean_Baseline, Mean_Treatment) %>%
      left_join(
        all_res_df %>% dplyr::select(peak_id_join, pvalue, FDR, Fold, PvalueDiffPeak, FDRDiffPeak, PrimaryDiffPeak, NominalDiffPeak, DiffPeakClass),
        by = "peak_id_join"
      )

    scatter_data <- scatter_data %>%
      mutate(
        Significance = case_when(
          PrimaryDiffPeak & Fold > 0 ~ "primaryUp",
          PrimaryDiffPeak & Fold < 0 ~ "primaryDown",
          TRUE ~ "nonSig"
        ),
        Significance = factor(Significance, levels = c("nonSig", "primaryDown", "primaryUp"))
      )

    p_scatter <- ggplot(scatter_data, aes(x = log2(Mean_Baseline + 1), y = log2(Mean_Treatment + 1), color = Significance)) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.72, size = 1.4) +
      scale_color_manual(values = pal_named(
        primaryUp = viz_pal$group[treatment_group],
        primaryDown = viz_pal$group[baseline_group],
        nonSig = viz_pal$neutral_mid
      )) +
      geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = viz_pal$neutral["dark"]) +
      labs(
        title = paste("Scatter Plot of Differential Peaks (", treatment_group, " vs ", baseline_group, ")", sep = ""),
        x = paste0("Log2(Mean ", baseline_group, " Normalized Counts + 1)"),
        y = paste0("Log2(Mean ", treatment_group, " Normalized Counts + 1)")
      ) +
      theme_atac_classic(base_size = 12)

    if(emit_light_plots) {
      print(p_scatter)
      save_gg_dual(step_plot_file("Step5", "Scatter_Plot_DiffPeaks.pdf"), p_scatter, width = 8, height = 8)
    }

    top_heatmap_ids <- res_df %>%
      arrange(pvalue, FDR, desc(abs(Fold))) %>%
      slice_head(n = 100) %>%
      pull(peak_id_join)

    heatmap_df <- counts_norm %>%
      dplyr::select(peak_id, peak_id_join, all_of(sample_cols)) %>%
      filter(peak_id_join %in% top_heatmap_ids)

    if(nrow(heatmap_df) > 1) {
      write.csv(heatmap_df, step_table_file("Step5", "Top_DiffPeaks_Sample_Matrix.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
      if(emit_light_plots) {
        heatmap_mat <- as.matrix(heatmap_df[, sample_cols, drop = FALSE])
        rownames(heatmap_mat) <- heatmap_df$peak_id
        heatmap_mat <- t(scale(t(log2(heatmap_mat + 1))))
        cluster_display_mat <- heatmap_mat
        cluster_display_mat[!is.finite(cluster_display_mat)] <- 0
        heatmap_row_cluster <- stats::hclust(stats::dist(cluster_display_mat))

        sample_anno <- data.frame(
          Group = factor(sample_group(sample_cols), levels = group_levels),
          row.names = sample_cols
        )

        draw_pheatmap_dual(
          step_plot_file("Step5", "Top_DiffPeaks_Heatmap.pdf"),
          width = 8,
          height = 10,
          legend_title = "Row Z-score",
          pheatmap(
            heatmap_mat,
            cluster_rows = heatmap_row_cluster,
            cluster_cols = FALSE,
            annotation_col = sample_anno,
            annotation_colors = list(Group = viz_pal$group),
            color = viz_pal$heat_meth,
            breaks = seq(-2.5, 2.5, length.out = length(viz_pal$heat_meth) + 1),
            legend_breaks = c(-2.5, 0, 2.5), legend_labels = c("≤-2.5", "0", "≥2.5"),
            na_col = unname(pfos_palette("neutral")["missing"]),
            show_rownames = FALSE,
            fontsize_col = 10
          )
        )
      }
    } else {
      write_skipped_state(
        "Step5",
        "Top_DiffPeaks_Heatmap",
        paste("Fewer than two primary differential peaks have exact matched count intervals under", primary_diff_peak_label(), "."),
        clear_plot_files = "Top_DiffPeaks_Heatmap.pdf"
      )
    }
  } else {
    write_skipped_state(
      "Step5",
      "Scatter_Plot_DiffPeaks",
      "Sample counts on the exact tested DiffBind intervals were unavailable; raw consensus regions cannot substitute for summit-centred test intervals.",
      clear_plot_files = "Scatter_Plot_DiffPeaks.pdf"
    )
    write_skipped_state(
      "Step5",
      "Top_DiffPeaks_Heatmap",
      "Sample counts on the exact tested DiffBind intervals were unavailable for the heatmap.",
      clear_plot_files = "Top_DiffPeaks_Heatmap.pdf"
    )
  }
} else {
  write_skipped_state(
    "Step5",
    "Volcano_Plot",
    "No DiffBind sites were available for volcano plotting.",
    clear_plot_files = "Volcano_Plot.pdf"
  )
}

# --- 高级图表 4: 差异 Peak 的 Venn 图 (Venn Diagram) ---
# 展示 Reference 和 Comparison 组特有及共有的 Peak
# 提取两组的共有 Peak (Consensus peaks)
if(exists("atac_dba") && !is.null(atac_dba) && !atac_primary_require_fc) {
  tryCatch(
    draw_base_plot_dual(
      step_plot_file("Step5", "DiffPeaks_Venn.pdf"),
      width = 8,
      height = 6,
      atac_plot_direction_venn(atac_dba, contrast = 1, bDB = TRUE, bGain = TRUE, bLoss = TRUE, bAll = FALSE,
                   th = if(atac_significance_mode == "pvalue") atac_primary_p_cutoff else atac_diff_fdr_cutoff,
                   bUsePval = atac_significance_mode == "pvalue", method = DBA_DESEQ2)
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      handle_nonfatal(paste("DiffBind Venn plot failed:", e$message), step = "Step5")
      write_skipped_state(
        "Step5",
        "DiffPeaks_Venn",
        paste("DiffBind Venn plot failed:", e$message),
        clear_plot_files = "DiffPeaks_Venn.pdf"
      )
    }
  )
} else {
  write_skipped_state(
    "Step5",
    "DiffPeaks_Venn",
    "DiffBind object unavailable or the primary FC gate is enabled; dba.plotVenn does not accept the required FC filter. Table-derived plots use the actual primary set.",
    clear_plot_files = "DiffPeaks_Venn.pdf"
  )
}
```

### 3.1 Direction-stratified chromatin context

把差异 peak 按 comparison-open 和 reference-open 两个方向拆开，比较它们对应的功能区域、到 TSS 的距离和 peak 宽度。

```{r direction_stratified_context, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
direction_context_df <- data.frame()
direction_plot_files <- c(
  "Directional_Chromatin_Context.pdf",
  "Directional_Annotation_Composition.pdf",
  "Directional_DistToTSS.pdf",
  "Directional_TSS_Density.pdf",
  "Directional_Peak_Width.pdf",
  "Directional_Peak_Width_Ridge.pdf"
)

if(nrow(res_df) > 0) {
  res_df_step3 <- res_df %>%
    mutate(
      seqnames = ensure_ucsc_seqnames(seqnames),
      peak_id = paste(seqnames, start, end, sep = ":"),
      peak_id_join = canonical_peak_id(seqnames, start, end)
    )

  diff_gr_step3 <- GRanges(
    seqnames = res_df_step3$seqnames,
    ranges = IRanges(start = res_df_step3$start, end = res_df_step3$end)
  )
  diff_gr_step3 <- keep_primary_chromosomes(diff_gr_step3)

  if(length(diff_gr_step3) > 0) {
    diff_anno_step3 <- tryCatch(
      annotatePeak(diff_gr_step3, TxDb = txdb, tssRegion = c(-2000, 2000), annoDb = "org.Mm.eg.db"),
      error = function(e) {
        handle_nonfatal(paste("Direction-stratified context annotation failed:", e$message), step = "Step5")
        NULL
      }
    )

    if(!is.null(diff_anno_step3)) {
      direction_context_df <- as.data.frame(diff_anno_step3)
      if("SYMBOL" %in% colnames(direction_context_df) && !"geneSymbol" %in% colnames(direction_context_df)) {
        colnames(direction_context_df)[colnames(direction_context_df) == "SYMBOL"] <- "geneSymbol"
      }
      direction_context_df <- direction_context_df %>%
        mutate(
          seqnames = ensure_ucsc_seqnames(seqnames),
          peak_id = paste(seqnames, start, end, sep = ":"),
          peak_id_join = canonical_peak_id(seqnames, start, end)
        ) %>%
        left_join(
          res_df_step3 %>% dplyr::select(peak_id_join, Fold, FDR, pvalue),
          by = "peak_id_join"
        ) %>%
        mutate(
          Direction = direction_factor(Fold),
          FeatureGroup = factor(derive_feature_layer(annotation), levels = feature_layer_levels),
          PeakWidth = end - start + 1,
          DistToTSSKb = distanceToTSS / 1000
        ) %>%
        filter(Direction %in% c(reference_open_label, comparison_open_label))

      save_step_table(direction_context_df, "Step5", "Directional_Chromatin_Context.csv")

      if(nrow(direction_context_df) == 0) {
        direction_feature_summary <- data.frame()
        direction_tss_summary <- data.frame()
        save_step_table(direction_feature_summary, "Step5", "Directional_Feature_Summary.csv")
        save_step_table(direction_tss_summary, "Step5", "Directional_Context_Summary.csv")
        write_skipped_state(
          "Step5",
          "Directional_Chromatin_Context",
          paste("Differential peak annotation completed, but no peaks could be assigned to", comparison_open_label, "or", reference_open_label, "after coordinate matching."),
          clear_plot_files = direction_plot_files
        )
      } else {
        direction_feature_summary <- direction_context_df %>%
          count(Direction, FeatureGroup, name = "PeakCount") %>%
          group_by(Direction) %>%
          mutate(Fraction = PeakCount / sum(PeakCount)) %>%
          ungroup() %>%
          arrange(Direction, desc(Fraction))
        save_step_table(direction_feature_summary, "Step5", "Directional_Feature_Summary.csv")

        direction_tss_summary <- direction_context_df %>%
          group_by(Direction) %>%
          summarise(
            PeakCount = n(),
            MedianDistToTSSKb = median(DistToTSSKb, na.rm = TRUE),
            MedianPeakWidth = median(PeakWidth, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop"
          )
        save_step_table(direction_tss_summary, "Step5", "Directional_Context_Summary.csv")
        save_step_table(
          direction_context_df %>% dplyr::select(peak_id, Direction, FeatureGroup, DistToTSSKb, PeakWidth, Fold, FDR),
          "Step5",
          "Directional_Context_Long.csv"
        )

        if(should_render_plots()) {
          direction_peak_colors <- stats::setNames(
            c(viz_pal$de[reference_open_label], viz_pal$de[comparison_open_label], viz_pal$de["Neutral"]),
            c(reference_open_label, comparison_open_label, "Neutral")
          )

          p_direction_context <- ggplot(direction_feature_summary, aes(x = Direction, y = Fraction, fill = FeatureGroup)) +
            geom_col(width = 0.72, color = viz_pal$neutral["light"]) +
            scale_fill_manual(values = resolve_named_colors(feature_layer_levels, viz_pal$feature, fallback_colors = viz_pal$feature_accent)) +
            scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
            theme_atac_classic(base_size = 12) +
            labs(
              title = "Direction-stratified chromatin context",
              subtitle = paste(comparison_open_label, "vs", reference_open_label, "differential peaks"),
              x = NULL,
              y = "Fraction of differential peaks",
              fill = "Feature group"
            )
          save_plot_pdf(p_direction_context, step_plot_file("Step5", "Directional_Chromatin_Context.pdf"), width = 8, height = 6)
          save_plot_pdf(p_direction_context, step_plot_file("Step5", "Directional_Annotation_Composition.pdf"), width = 8, height = 6)

          p_direction_tss <- ggplot(direction_context_df, aes(x = DistToTSSKb, fill = Direction, color = Direction)) +
            geom_density(alpha = 0.22, linewidth = 0.9) +
            xlim(-100, 100) +
            scale_fill_manual(values = direction_peak_colors) +
            scale_color_manual(values = direction_peak_colors) +
            theme_atac_classic(base_size = 12) +
            labs(
              title = "Distance to TSS by accessibility direction",
              x = "Distance to TSS (kb)",
              y = "Density"
            )
          save_plot_pdf(p_direction_tss, step_plot_file("Step5", "Directional_DistToTSS.pdf"), width = 8, height = 6)
          save_plot_pdf(p_direction_tss, step_plot_file("Step5", "Directional_TSS_Density.pdf"), width = 8, height = 6)

          if(requireNamespace("ggridges", quietly = TRUE)) {
            p_direction_width <- ggplot(direction_context_df, aes(x = PeakWidth, y = Direction, fill = Direction, color = Direction)) +
              ggridges::geom_density_ridges(alpha = 0.35, scale = 1.05, linewidth = 0.9, rel_min_height = 0.01) +
              scale_fill_manual(values = direction_peak_colors) +
              scale_color_manual(values = direction_peak_colors) +
              theme_atac_classic(base_size = 12, legend = "none") +
              labs(
                title = "Peak width ridge profile by accessibility direction",
                x = "Peak width (bp)",
                y = NULL
              )
          } else {
            p_direction_width <- ggplot(direction_context_df, aes(x = PeakWidth, color = Direction, fill = Direction)) +
              geom_density(alpha = 0.2, linewidth = 0.95) +
              facet_wrap(~Direction, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
              scale_fill_manual(values = direction_peak_colors) +
              scale_color_manual(values = direction_peak_colors) +
              theme_atac_classic(base_size = 12, legend = "none") +
              labs(
                title = "Peak width density by accessibility direction",
                x = "Peak width (bp)",
                y = "Density"
              )
          }
          save_plot_pdf(p_direction_width, step_plot_file("Step5", "Directional_Peak_Width.pdf"), width = 7, height = 6)
          save_plot_pdf(p_direction_width, step_plot_file("Step5", "Directional_Peak_Width_Ridge.pdf"), width = 8, height = 6)
        }
      }
    } else {
      write_skipped_state(
        "Step5",
        "Directional_Chromatin_Context",
        "Differential peak annotation failed for direction-stratified context.",
        clear_plot_files = direction_plot_files
      )
    }
  } else {
    write_skipped_state(
      "Step5",
      "Directional_Chromatin_Context",
      paste("No primary-chromosome differential peaks passed", primary_diff_peak_label(), "."),
      clear_plot_files = direction_plot_files
    )
  }
} else {
  write_skipped_state(
    "Step5",
    "Directional_Chromatin_Context",
    "No differential peaks detected.",
    clear_plot_files = direction_plot_files
  )
}
```
